import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    D = float(next(it))

    p = [0.0] * N
    c = [0.0] * N
    for i in range(N):
        p[i] = float(next(it))
        c[i] = float(next(it))

    dp = [float('inf')] * N
    dp[0] = 0.0

    for i in range(1, N):
        best = float('inf')
        pi = p[i]
        for j in range(i):
            dist = pi - p[j]
            val = dp[j] + (dist * dist) / c[j]
            if val < best:
                best = val
        dp[i] = best

    ans = float('inf')
    for j in range(N):
        dist = D - p[j]
        val = dp[j] + (dist * dist) / c[j]
        if val < ans:
            ans = val

    print(f"{ans:.3f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
